description: Configure roles that are always temporary. When a user receives one of these roles (by any means), the role will automatically be removed after the configured duration.

content.name: roleID
content.description: The role that should always be temporary. When a user receives this role, it will be automatically removed after the configured duration.

content.name: duration
content.description: How long the role should last before being automatically removed. Examples: 1h, 12h, 1d, 7d, 30m
